title: Publish tests of a WordPress card judge the group they name, not the coverage file the borrowed contract lacks
steps: Run the Publish cases of tracy-web's ops quickstarts suite against Postgres (TEST_DATABASE_URL).
expect: A card served by a lower contract publishes with exactly one LOWER_CONTRACT warning (200).
A card bound exactly to its contract publishes with no warning (200).
A release whose contract declares no slot roles is refused 400 CONTENT_COVERAGE_NOT_READY with a reason naming slot roles, and its road step is todo coverage-roles.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=Publish of a (card served|card bound|release whose contract declares no slot)
tests: Publish of a card served by a lower contract still publishes, with a warning
Publish of a card bound exactly to a contract publishes without a warning
Publish of a release whose contract declares no slot roles is held by Content coverage (ADR 0038)
